data.title: Ray Dalio says Bessent move is sign that a debt crisis is getting closer; recommends gold and bitcoin
data.description: Billionaire investor Ray Dalio said the the debt buyback announcement this week fits into a larger pattern that could signal a forthcoming debt crisis.
data.author: Alex Harring
